advise_catalyst.text: You run on your existing stores, and that feels like energy until it runs out. Take a class in something nobody pays you for. Keep one evening a week with no plans. Ask someone older how they did it and listen past the first sentence. Nap before the next idea.

acts: Take a class in something nobody pays you for.

Ask someone older how they did it and listen past the first sentence.
Nap before the next idea.

advise_friction.text: Seek Metal, the Action energy. Metal is the finished line, the point where a thing is decided and sent on its way. Let it spend what Wood piles up. You keep what you take in, ideas and people alike, because letting go feels like loss. Decide one open question by a written date. Hand someone one unfinished page.

advise_catalyst.text: Your strength runs on what you put back, and putting back is the part you skip. Refuel on purpose. Sleep before the second wind arrives. Eat with a peer once a week and let them pay. Ask one person for help on a job you usually do alone. Sit still for ten minutes a day.

Sleep before the second wind arrives.
Eat with a peer once a week and let them pay.
Ask one person for help on a job you usually do alone.
Sit still for ten minutes a day.

advise_friction.text: Seek Water, the Order energy. Water runs cool and keeps to its banks, and a blaze meets it only on the water's terms. Let it shape what your Fire burns. You mistake being unstoppable for being well. Hand one project to a deadline someone else set. Ask the person above you which fire to put out first.

advise_catalyst.text: What you keep inside does not count as finished. Make one thing a week that someone else can hold. Say the opinion you have been sitting on to one person. Show a child or a friend something you know how to do. Write one line down before bed.

advise_friction.text: Seek Wood, the Mind energy. Wood is slow growth, roots holding ground and leaves fed by rain, something in you before anything comes out. Let it take in what Earth keeps handing out. Whatever you feel or think leaves you before it has had time to grow. Read one chapter ahead of giving an opinion.

advise_catalyst.text: Your drive is short, and each piece of it needs a clear place to go. Say yes to one opening and no to the next two out loud. Move a fixed sum into savings each month before you spend the rest. Take whoever you love somewhere new and close by. Empty your pockets into a jar each night.

You spend your strength on what you claim before yourself, and tired is where you make your worst deals. Sleep on any new venture before you answer.

advise_catalyst.text: You do your best work with a date on it and someone waiting at the other end. Give each big plan a finish line before you start it. Once a month, hand a decision to someone whose call you will keep. Tell one person your deadline. Set a stop time before you begin.
